actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: FlyGym is the Python library for NeuroMechFly v2, a digital twin of the adult fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster
The biomechanical model is based on a micro-CT scan of a real adult female fly
The card's first model is the MJCF document whose root element is '<mujoco model="fruitfly">'
The model compiles angles in radians and derives limits automatically (autolimits true)
The model integrates at 0.0001 s per step (0.1 ms) with gravity 0 0 -981
The thorax is a free-floating body: the model declares the freejoint named free on the thorax body
The wing default class gives its actuators a control range of -1 to 1
The six wing actuators are wing_yaw_left, wing_roll_left, wing_pitch_left, wing_yaw_right, wing_roll_right and wing_pitch_right
The adhesion default classes give the labrum and claw adhesion actuators a control range of 0 to 1
The eight adhesion actuators are adhere_labrum_left, adhere_labrum_right and the claw actuators adhere_claw_T1, T2 and T3 for the left and right sides

The leg default classes declare control ranges such as twist_coxa_T1 -0.8 to 0.8, abduct_coxa_T1 -1 to 0.7, extend_coxa_T1 -0.2 to 1.7, twist_femur -1 to 1, extend_femur -0.15 to 2, extend_tibia -1.35 to 1.3 and extend_tarsus -0.36 to 0.36

The actuator section declares 78 actuators: 70 general actuators driving head, antenna, wing, abdomen, leg, tarsus and tendon targets, and 8 adhesion actuators attached to the labrum and the six claws
The model declares 15 sensors: an accelerometer, a gyro and a velocimeter on the thorax, six force sensors on the tarsi and six touch sensors on the claws

determinism.notes: the model contains no random element and MuJoCo integrates it deterministically from the reset state; the package's stand-in backend is deterministic too, but its placeholder motion is not the engine's physics

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the served fruitfly.xml for the 102 hinge joints, the free joint, the 78 actuator ctrlranges and the 0.1 ms step, then moves each joint-driven actuator toward its control value; it computes no inertia, contact, adhesion, tendon or actuator dynamics, so no trajectory here is a MuJoCo result

the stand-in loads no mesh or texture and resolves no contact, adhesion, exclusion, tendon or equality constraint: the 8 adhesion actuators, the 26 contact exclusions and the 85 mesh references of the model are not applied
the model's 15 sensors (accelerometer, gyro, velocimeter, six force and six touch sites) and its nine cameras are not exposed; only the bridge's time, qpos, qvel and ctrl state is published
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine

the card's entry symbol flygym_demo.muscle_imitation.env:ImitationEnv is a Gymnasium wrapper that needs flygym, gymnasium, numpy and a built Simulation; this package serves the card's models[0] MJCF through the card's MujocoDriver and does not run that environment
no physical fly is modelled and nothing was validated against the animal

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the integration state stays readable
